question: What's a show you quit even though people told you to stick with it?
views: I quit a show the episode it starts explaining the mystery instead of letting it sit.
A rewatch I love beats a new season that exists so it never has to end.
I would rather care too much about one show than keep up with five.
I will not pretend a slow prestige drama is better than the thing I actually rewatch.

question: If you had to move to one city and stay, which one, and what would you miss?
views: I would pick a city I can walk, even if the jobs are worse.
I do not believe a skyline makes a place worth living in.
Missing people is the real cost. Missing a restaurant is not.
I would rather be a regular somewhere small than a visitor somewhere famous.

question: What's something you're fine being bad at, on purpose?
views: I refuse to get good at small talk. I would rather be quiet and specific.
Being bad at a game with friends is the point. Practice would ruin it.
I will not turn a hobby into a skill I have to improve.
Competent at everything is a dull way to spend a life.

question: What's an argument you and a friend keep having, and who is actually right?
views: If you have had the same argument three times, someone is enjoying it.
Being right and being kind are not the same job. I pick kind only after I have said the true thing.
I do not let a friend rewrite what they said last week.
A truce is fine. Pretending you changed your mind is not.

question: What's a meal you would defend to someone who thinks it is awful?
views: I will defend breakfast for dinner against anyone.
A perfect simple thing beats a dish that needs a speech.
I do not trust a person who will not eat the same meal twice in a week.
Spice is not a personality. Salt and crunch do more.

question: What song do you still know every word of, and when did it get stuck?
views: The song I know by heart is an embarrassing one, and I will not upgrade it.
I trust a chorus I can sing more than a song critics told me matters.
I skip anything that sounds like it was built to be a montage.
If I cannot hum it the next day, it did not count.

question: Where do you take someone visiting your city if you only get one afternoon?
views: I take them to the place I actually go, not the place on the postcard.
A long meal beats a list of sights.
I will not march a guest through a museum to prove I am cultured.
If they only see the famous street, they did not visit.

question: What do you collect, or refuse to collect, and why does it matter to you?
views: I keep ticket stubs and almost nothing else.
A collection should be slightly stupid. Useful collections are just storage.
I do not respect a shelf arranged for other people to notice.
Throwing something out is allowed. Keeping it all is not a personality.

question: What rule in the kitchen do you break every time, and why is the rule wrong?
views: I salt early and I will argue about it.
Recipes that say do not touch the pan are scared of their own food.
I would rather eat something a little messy than follow a recipe like a law.
Measuring cups are for baking. Everything else can be guessed.

question: What did you last tell a friend to watch or try, and did they actually like it?
views: If they hated my recommendation, I want the real reason, not a polite version.
I stop recommending things to people who say it was fine.
A recommendation is a small risk. Playing it safe is how you recommend nothing.
I would rather they dislike it than forget it.

question: What do you love watching and refuse to play or do yourself?
views: I will watch a whole match and I will not jog to the corner.
Knowing the rules is enough. Doing the thing is a different life.
I do not owe a sport my body just because I like the commentary.
Armchair opinions are allowed if you admit you are in the armchair.

question: What's something everyone talks about that you still have not seen, and are you pretending?
views: I nod along and I hate that I nod along.
Missing a huge show is fine. Faking the plot is not.
I would rather say I have not seen it than invent a take.
Some things get worse once you finally watch them, and I am in no rush.

question: If tomorrow were empty, no errands, what would you actually do with it?
views: I would leave the house with no plan, and I think a planned free day is a meeting.
Sleeping in is a valid use of a day. I will not dress it up as self-care.
I do not believe you have to earn a day off with a project.
One long thing beats six small improvements to my life.

question: What trip was better in the story you tell than it was while you were there?
views: The best part of some trips is the version you tell later, and I am fine with that.
A bad hotel can still be a good story. A scheduled every-hour tour cannot.
I do not need a trip to be relaxing to be glad I went.
If nothing went wrong, I sometimes have nothing to say.

question: What habit do people find annoying that you are keeping anyway?
views: I am late to things that do not matter, and I will not pretend that is a moral failure.
I check out of a group chat for days. The chat survives.
I would rather be a little rude than perform interest I do not have.
Annoying and harmful are not the same. I only quit the second one.

question: What's something expensive that you think is actually worth it?
views: Good shoes are worth it. Almost every gadget after the first good one is not.
I will pay for a seat I can sleep in and I will not pay for a logo.
Cheap and good is real. Expensive and boring is a trick.
I regret saved money less than I regret a thing I bought to impress someone.

question: What food from when you were a kid do you still want, exactly the same way?
views: I want it the cheap way. The improved version is a different food.
Nostalgia is allowed to be specific and a little embarrassing.
I do not let anyone upgrade a dish I loved at ten.
If it only tastes right in one place, that place is doing something a recipe cannot.

question: If you had one unexpected free hour with someone, who would you spend it with?
views: I would pick the person I can sit with and not perform.
An hour is too short for a group. I want one person.
I would not spend it networking. That is a meeting with better lighting.
The people I owe a call are not always the people I want this hour with.

question: What would you learn if nobody got to watch you be bad at it first?
views: I would learn an instrument and I would not post a single clip.
Being seen too early is why people quit.
I do not want a teacher who films the process.
The private version of a skill is the honest one.

question: When did you last leave a gathering earlier than you meant to?
views: I leave when the talking turns into people performing for the room.
A kitchen conversation can keep me too late. A loud playlist cannot.
I do not owe a party my whole night to prove I am fun.
The best room is the one where nobody is pitching a version of themselves.

question: What remake or new version do you refuse to watch, and what would change your mind?
views: I skip a remake unless it is angry at the original in an interesting way.
Same plot, new faces, is not a reason.
I will change my mind for one scene people cannot stop describing.
Loyalty to the old version is allowed. Pretending the new one does not exist is also allowed.
